description: Senator Nikki Merritt is a dedicated Democrat, representing the Georgia's 9th District that encompasses segments of Gwinnett County. Senator Merritt currently serves on the following committees: including Children and Families, Government Oversight, Insurance and Labor, Natural Resources and the Environment, and Urban Affairs. Additionally, is also the Chair of the Gwinnett County Senate Delegation and Vice Chair of the Georgia Legislative Black Caucus. Support Nikki Merritt for Georgia.
